Rae: Heads-up: after the routing tweak p95 (90ms) < p50 (160ms) on /v1/generate in eu-central for the 10m window. Can someone quick-check?
Omar: Can you paste the query you ran?
Rae: ```SELECT sample_origin, count(*) c, percentile(response_ms,0.95) p95, percentile(response_ms,0.5) p50 FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='eu-central' AND ts>now()-10m GROUP BY sample_origin;```
Linh: Results?
Rae: warmpool: c=800 p95=18 p50=12; primary: c=250 p95=420 p50=190; merged: p95=90 p50=160.
Omar: Classic sampling/rollup distortion. Our rollups use raw sample counts; sampler multiplies warmpool events so merged tdigest is overweighted.
Linh: Short-term: console should show per-origin percentiles by default and a small "provenance" badge when origins>1 and variance high.
Omar: Medium-term: telemetry change to include effective_count per origin and perform weight-aware tdigest merges. Add smokecheck to pre-rollout checklist: run a 10m query and fail if merged_p95 < merged_p50.
Rae: I'll add the dashboard panel that compares merged vs per-origin p50/p95 and file the console PR.
DashboardBot: Created incident INC-2026-067: "percentile-provenance-eu-central". Tasks: console-badge, telemetry-weighted-merge, pre-rollout-smokecheck. https://redwood/internal/inc/INC-2026-067
Linh: Filed the runbook snippet and will add the SQL repro to the incident.
Omar: I'll sketch the telemetry PR and include unit tests for skewed sampling.
Rae: Thanks all, tagging eng-runtime in the incident to add the smokecheck to routing rollouts. :white_check_mark:
